column1: # Why measures: a four-bit BSIM3 adder stepped at 500 ps against 5 ns
# input edges. The pointwise gate trips on 92 samples of the sum and
# carry outputs, every one a trapezoidal ringing tail at the low rail:
# reference values of 1e-5..8e-4 V against RSpice tails of up to 8 mV on
# 3.4 V nodes (0.25 percent of the swing). The tails are the grid's, not
# the circuit's — refining ngspice's own step 10x collapses its 3.4e-4 V
# tail at 33 ns to 2.3e-6 V. The engineering content is stable: under
# refinement the reference's output crossings move by at most 37 ps and
# its overshoot peaks by 28 mV (ngspice-46 and -47 also differ by up to
# 41 ps and 29 mV at the deck step); RSpice's crossings sit within 76 ps,
# its peaks within 50 mV (1.4 percent), and its settled rails match to
# Sources: VIN1A..VIN4B PULSE 0->3 V with 5 ns edges at 50 ns..6.4 us
# periods. V(9)..V(12) = sum bits, V(13) = carry out. Tolerances are
# twice the larger of the reference's refinement movement and RSpice's
